S-RUNTIME-PLATFORM.Purpose: Game-side runtime substrate of FlexVerse: the Unity host object, behavior ownership and tick scheduling, and the reactive property-slot contract consumed by widget code.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Unity MonoBehaviour host: root object lifecycle, mod entry, settings.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Behavior reference counting and per-owner subscription tracking.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Global time tick over weakly-referenced subscribed behaviors, with throttling.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: Abstract property-slot contract (IPropertyRef) and its Bind/Watch realizations.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Widget tree, layout, input, rendering — owned by S-WIDGETS.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Behavior interpolation math — owned by S-BEHAVIORS.

Principles.PRIN-001: Runtime must not keep strong references to mod-owned behaviors: ticking walks weak references.
Principles.PRIN-002: Subscriptions are always owner-scoped so an unmounting owner releases all handlers at once.

Requirements.REQ-001: Exactly one FlexVerseRoot exists per session and it owns the global registry and updater.
Requirements.REQ-002: A behavior whose owner was collected stops being ticked without manual unregistration.
Requirements.REQ-003: WatchRef resubscribes when the behavior instance in a slot is replaced (M-WATCH-REF.REQ-001).
